runtime_semantics.regular_material_rule: CEX neighborhood mask, deterministic first variant cex[mask*3]
runtime_semantics.tick_zero_model: sub_80A3440 publishes the raw PAL, then ReadAnimatedColorData initializes timers/currentColor without publishing it; sub_80A3BB0 initializes map render contexts only. Thus tick 0 is the raw PAL and CANM color 0 first appears when that record's timer expires.
runtime_semantics.water_default_rule: default terrain 3 only when gDungeonWaterType[tileset] == WATER (2), else 0
